content.comment_body: Forgot your password for [product_name]. Looking for guidance on uploading a new project or bypassing the password. The [product_name] contains a password but no saved project.
Your help is greatly appreciated, it was very useful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter issues accessing [product_name] after forgetting the password and seek advice on password reset or recovery. Community members share default password information, indicating reliance on peer-contributed solutions rather than official password recovery features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a simple and effective way to recover or reset forgotten passwords in order to regain access and upload new projects to their devices.
